nominalDiameterInches.notes: Nominal size class; actual frame outside diameter is 261 mm.

depth.notes: Frontmost flange/gasket surface to rearmost body; not installed rear projection.

flangeAssemblyDepth.notes: Drawing frontmost flange/gasket surface to rear mounting face; gasket compression is unspecified.

mountingFaceOffset.notes: Rear underside of flange/gasket assembly chosen as mounting datum.

rearProjection.notes: 113 mm overall axial depth minus 13 mm front-to-mounting-face offset.

cutoutDiameter.notes: Also published as baffle cutout diameter on PDF page 2.

boltHoleDiameter.notes: Drawing specifies 4 x diameter 7 minimum; manufacturing upper tolerance is not given.

boltStartAngle.notes: Four holes at cardinal axes in inspected face view.

magnetDiameter.notes: Scaled maximum motor radius from side drawing; not a dimensioned specification.

magnetStartZ.notes: Scaled basket-to-motor transition measured rearward from the chosen mounting face.

driverOccupiedVolume.location: PDF page 2, Air Volume Occupied by Driver
driverOccupiedVolume.notes: Published displacement; do not infer displaced volume from the rendered mesh.

terminalClearance.location: PDF page 5 rear and side views
terminalClearance.notes: Terminal hardware is shown, but wire bend and service clearance are not dimensioned.

geometry.datum: mounting face z=0; positive z rearward. The datum is the rear underside of the 13 mm flange/gasket assembly; drawing front is z=-13 mm and rear is z=100 mm.

parts.name: Maximum radial envelope
parts.notes: Conservative circumscribed clearance cylinder only; it is not a material model.

parts.name: Circular flange and gasket assembly
parts.notes: Outer diameter and axial depth are dimensioned. Inner opening is represented by the baffle cutout; gasket steps, local recesses and holes are not reconstructed.

parts.name: Bolt axes - mounting guides
parts.notes: Four dimensioned 7 mm minimum mounting-hole guides. These guides do not subtract holes from the appearance flange.

parts.name: Baffle cutout - guide
parts.notes: Dimensioned circular cutout guide; not driver material.

parts.name: Basket maximum appearance envelope
parts.notes: Scaled, rotationalized basket envelope only. Actual basket has ribs and open windows; these undimensioned details are intentionally not asserted. The mesh must not supply displaced air or front-chamber volume.

parts.name: Motor and rear cover appearance
parts.notes: Rear endpoint follows the dimensioned 100 mm installed projection. Motor diameter, transition depth and cover taper are scaled appearance values; motor internals are absent.

unresolved: Motor and basket contours are scaled approximations; individual ribs, basket windows, local flange recesses and motor internals are not reconstructed.
Cone, surround and dustcap contours are not dimensioned and are omitted rather than inferred from Sd.
Terminal projection, wire bend and tool-access clearance require physical-part verification.
Gasket compression and manufacturing tolerances are not given in the inspected datasheet.
notes: Mechanical reconstruction and published motor data do not establish MEH acoustic suitability; the chosen horn and loading still require fit and acoustic checks.
Drawing dimensions and approximate appearance surfaces retain separate provenance.
Published occupied air volume is 1.5 L; rendered envelopes and surfaces must not be integrated to infer driver displacement.

audit.scope: Existing-catalogue geometry, units, source identities and mounting datum audit
audit.reason: Manufacturing tolerances, terminal/wire/tool clearance and some external profiles are incomplete. Drawing dimensions and conservative bounds are not exact CAD.
